description: Canonical UXLC Leningrad Devarim fragments. Each is a multi-codepoint Hebrew phrase (consonants + nikkud + trop) that uniquely identifies UXLC-derived content. Used by test_contamination.py to grep llm_calls.jsonl for any leak of GT-derived signal into LLM prompts (D-05 contamination boundary).
source: Public-domain Leningrad UXLC samples; Tanach.us / Open Siddur consonants+nikkud+trop. Public-domain text only — no Yosef-private material.
notes: Add fragments as Phase 3 expands beyond the Shema fixture.
Fragments must be byte-equal to UXLC source (no normalization — preserve U+034F CGJ).

If a future LLM prompt legitimately needs to mention a Hebrew letter (e.g., 'transcribe each אות (letter)'), the prompt template MUST be re-engineered to use a generic instruction; alternatively, add a NARROW exclusion mechanism to this fixture — but the default is: Hebrew text in a prompt = contamination.
